issue_request: FHIR-13742 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core issue asking FHIR-I to formalize the common unofficial `_pretty=true` parameter for clients that want pretty-printed responses.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 12830, and git commit f40ead5f8ec27b18de2fde36556825c3a0663a68 (`#13742 - document _pretty parameter`) added the `_pretty` text, example, true/false values, and optional support language to `source/http.html`.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-16438 refined the same area by moving `_pretty` into the general HTTP parameters table and changing the support wording to `servers MAY choose to support this parameter`; FHIR-16438 is already represented on the combined branch. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no substantive later decision that reverses or narrows the FHIR-13742 behavior.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current `source/http.html` lists `_pretty` with the general interaction parameters and defines `GET [base]/Patient/example?_pretty=true`, true/false values, and optional server support.
